latest_release.name: November 12, 2026
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

### Resumable Agent streams (now for every Agent)
Every `Agent` can now publish a resumable run stream with replay caching, cross-instance observe/abort (`agent.observe(runId)`, `observe().abort()`, `agent.abortRunStream(runId)`), and ownership/TTL enforcement—so clients can reconnect without killing the run by default.

### Built-in MCP server at `/api/mcp` + OAuth discovery
`@mastra/server` now ships a built-in MCP endpoint (enabled by default when `server.auth` is configured) so MCP clients can call your agents/workflows/tools without defining an `MCPServer`, plus OAuth discovery/audience checks via `server.mcp.oauth` and a new introspection route `GET /api/mcp/builtin`.

### Workflow Storage Version 2 (delta writes) now supported on Postgres + libSQL
Experimental `storageVersion: 2` reduces writes by persisting only per-step changes (instead of rewriting the whole run) and now works with `@mastra/pg` and `@mastra/libsql`, with results that can lazily load step history via an async `steps()` function.

### Resumable AI SDK chat routes (`useChat({ resume: true })` support)
`chatRoute({ resumable: true })` now generates a POST + reconnect GET endpoint pair that replays/follows active runs via `agent.observe(runId)`, with explicit route-array configuration support (`server.apiRoutes: [routes]`).

### One-off and bounded schedules for agents & workflows
Schedules now support one-time execution (`runAt`) and bounded recurring execution (`endAt`), with TypeScript updates (`cron` is optional) across server, client, and multiple storage backends.

### Breaking Changes
- `Agent`’s `durable` option now controls **resumable streams only** (not checkpoint-backed durable execution); migrate durable execution to `createDurableAgent({ agent })`, and note plain-agent disconnect behavior differs when streams are enabled.

## Changelog

### [@mastra/core@1.83.0](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/blob/@mastra/core@1.83.0/packages/core/CHANGELOG.md)
#### Minor Changes

- Added resumable streams to every `Agent`, not just durable agents. An agent registered on `Mastra` now publishes each run on its stream topic and keeps a replay cache, so a client can reconnect after a disconnect, another reader can follow the run with `agent.observe(runId)`, and any reader can stop it with `observe().abort()` or `agent.abortRunStream(runId)`. (#28424)

  _Also in: @mastra/server@1.83.0_

- Avoid blocking the event loop while loading instruction files from a trusted Git ref and while discovering tool-result instruction reminders. Keep missing and untrusted-ref behavior unchanged. (#30104)

  _Also in: @mastra/code-sdk@1.19.0_

- Add model and provider as span query sort fields. (#30096)

- Added `server.mcp.oauth` (`resource`, `requireAudience`, `authorizationServers`, `scopesSupported`) to configure OAuth discovery and token audience checks for the built-in MCP server. Auth providers can implement the new optional `getOAuthMetadata()` and `verifyAudience()` methods to advertise their authorization server and check the token audience. `CompositeAuth` combines the authorization servers of its providers and checks the audience with the provider that accepted the token. The new `CompositeAuth.getAuthenticatedProvider(user)` returns that provider. (#29930)

- Added the `server.mcp` option for configuring the built-in MCP server at `/api/mcp`: turn it on or off, change its path, choose toolsets, feature agents and workflows, serve only read-only tools, and include or exclude agents, workflows, and tools by id. (#29929)

- Added `memory`, `observability`, `observability_analytics`, and `stored_agents` to the toolsets accepted by `server.mcp.toolsets`. (#29931)

- Chat SDK logs from channels now use your Mastra logger, so they follow its format, level, and redact settings. These logs no longer print with the `[chat-sdk]` console prefix. To filter them, use `component: 'chat-sdk'`. Use the new `toChatLogger` ex
